points.statement: Aims to restore degraded images efficiently with a unified model.
points.quote: Restoring any degraded image efficiently via just one model

points.statement: Uses shared similarity among degradations to support efficient comprehensive restoration via a joint embedding mechanism.
points.quote: leverages inherent similarity across various degradations to enable both efficient and comprehensive restoration through a joint embedding mechanism

points.statement: Examines each input's sub-latent space, identifies key components, and reweights them initially in a gated manner.
points.quote: we examine the sub-latent space of each input, identifying key components and reweighting them first in a gated manner.

points.statement: Proposes a parallel spatial-frequency fusion strategy to enhance spatial-aware local-global interactions and enrich restoration details from the frequency perspective.
points.quote: a spatial-frequency parallel fusion strategy is proposed for enhancing spatial-aware local-global interactions and enriching the restoration details from the frequency perspective.
